releases.name: WoClaw Hub v0.5.0 — All-in-One Memory Platform
releases.body:
# WoClaw Hub v0.5.0 (2026-06-02)

> 自 0.4.3 (2026-04-05) 起完成的核心工作：All-in-One Memory Platform (Session Store / AI Extraction / Forgetting Scheduler)、Memory Encryption at Rest、Federation-aware Shared Memory、Session Archival、Web UI 增强、CI/CD 完善。
> npm 已发布：`woclaw-hub@0.5.0`（hub 子包），`woclaw-hooks@0.5.0`（hooks 子包）。Hub 子包版本领先 workspace meta-package 是设计：hub 走独立发布周期。

## ✨ Highlights

- 🧠 **All-in-One Memory Platform** — Session Store + AI 提取引擎（OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama）+ ForgettingScheduler
- 🔐 **Memory Encryption at Rest** — AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2，`ENC:v1:` 紧凑序列化
- 🌐 **Federation-aware Shared Memory** — Hub 之间自动同步高重要性记忆
- 📦 **Session Archival** — 遗忘前归档到 JSONL/ZIP，支持恢复
- 🎨 **Web UI 增强** — Memory Inspection Panel、Session Replay、Sessions Tab、Importance Heatmap
- 🛠️ **CI/CD 完善** — Node 22 升级、CI status / Docker Hub 徽章、`npm test` 步骤

## 📦 Package versions (npm)

- `woclaw-hub`: 0.4.3 → **0.5.0** ✅
- `woclaw-hooks`: 0.4.3 → **0.5.0** ✅
- `woclaw-mcp`: 0.1.2（无变化）
- `woclaw-codex`: 0.1.2（无变化）
- `xingp14-woclaw` (workspace meta): 0.4.3（待发布下一版）

## 📝 Full Changelog

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/XingP14/woclaw/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#050---2026-06-02) for the complete list of changes.

## 🐳 Docker

```bash
docker pull xingp14/woclaw-hub:0.5.0
```
